rule.description: Fires on method bodies whose implementation mass places them far beyond the codebase's healthy delegation profile (at least 108 HIR statements, 11% above the 97-statement largest well-factored method here): a body only reaches that mass by absorbing the implementations of its sub-methods, mixing orchestration with the absorbed steps' filesystem plumbing and mechanical details in place.

checks.description: Detect method bodies that absorbed the implementations of their sub-methods, identified by implementation mass far above the codebase's well-factored delegation profile, with the absorbed units' direct file plumbing corroborating the match.
checks.detected_relation: orchestration entry point -> inline bodies of its absorbed helper units
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The entry point no longer delegates its preparation steps; the sub-method implementations were copied into the host body, so policy decisions, version gating, filesystem plumbing, and mechanical re-encoding are interleaved in one place and the original one-responsibility-per-step decomposition is destroyed.

matches.evidence: The cargo environment-export step reads 391 HIR statements against 95 in the clean baseline, absorbing the wrapper-preparation procedure (the repository's largest helper at 97 statements, including rustflags-decoding and wrapper-path materialization), the OS-specific dependency setup, the cmake toolchain export, the per-language compiler-option probing with its nested probe closure, the no-op script writer, and the shared cache-directory resolution; 11 direct file-write sites and 8 direct file-read sites now execute in the host body itself.

The zig cc/c++/dlltool dispatch reads 145 HIR statements against 97 in the clean baseline, absorbing the dlltool dispatch with its pre-0.12 option filtering, the response-file decode/augment/rewrite for both the utf8 and utf16LE+BOM encodings, the undefined/dynamic_lookup mirroring and the -liconv-implies--lcharset pairing (each now evaluated twice against response-file contents and against the raw command line), the macOS SDKROOT/sysroot decoration, and the shim and .tbd stub materialization; 6 direct file-write sites and 5 direct file-read sites now execute in the host body itself.

excluded.reason: Largest remaining method (84 statements) with no direct filesystem plumbing in its body; below the delegation-profile threshold and untouched by this case.
Cohesive single-responsibility script writer left in its baseline shape; below the delegation-profile threshold.
Sibling tool dispatch (zig ar/ranlib/lib) kept at its baseline orchestration size; not an absorbed-helper host.
